question: Which order matches the pattern described in Judges 2?
options: God raises a judge → Israel serves Baals → enemies oppress Israel → the judge dies
Enemies oppress Israel → the judge dies → Israel serves Baals → God raises a judge
Israel serves Baals → enemies oppress Israel → God raises a judge → the judge dies and Israel turns away again
The judge dies → God raises a judge → enemies oppress Israel → Israel serves Baals
explanation: Israel served other gods, God gave them to their enemies, then He raised up a judge to save them. When the judge died, the people turned back to other gods.
